tests: NO TEST — nothing covers deleteMedia's reference guards, saveDocument's slot rules or the public publication gate

suggestedChecks: Authorization matrix: re-test every role against every protected operation. Auth changes have the widest blast radius and the quietest failures.
API contract: diff the implemented surface against the declared contract and re-test every consumer, including mobile clients still running older versions.
Runtime pass: route-smoke the affected pages, then drive a browser for the critical paths — static review cannot see render-time breakage.
Configuration: confirm every environment still has the variables it needs, and that nothing secret moved into a tracked file.
Mechanical analysis: run analyze.mjs --run before anything interpretive.
